annotations.title: Get a C and embedded interview practice problem

description: Gets one C and embedded interview practice problem by its id: the task, the provided header (types and prototypes), the functions to write, an example, three written hints and the starting code. Use this when the person picks a C practice problem or names one. The answer and the hidden tests are not included. Free, with no daily limit.

id.description: The problem's id, such as "c-ring-buffer", as in breadboardhub.com/practice/embedded/<id>.
